name: vectrazai
description: VectrazAI - AI & semiconductor/chip/GPU news portal monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n AUTH,MAIN,WEB -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w services/auth-service" "npm run dev -w services/main-service" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/db && npm run build -w services/auth-service && npm run build -w services/main-service && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.postinstall: npm run build --workspace=packages/db --if-present || echo '[postinstall] packages/db build failed or skipped - continuing (only auth-service/main-service actually need it)'
